abs.name: Federal Budget
abs.line: The federal government's budget as presented to the National Assembly: what it plans to spend and collect, and last year's revised figures.

cpi_monthly_review.name: Monthly Price Review
cpi_monthly_review.line: The Pakistan Bureau of Statistics' monthly report on consumer prices: the price index and inflation, for the country, towns and villages.

lfs_annual_report.name: Labour Force Survey
lfs_annual_report.line: The national survey of work: how many people are in the labour force, employed or unemployed, by sex, area and province.

pes_chapter.name: Pakistan Economic Survey
pes_chapter.line: The Finance Division's yearly review of the economy, one chapter per subject. We use it to cross-check figures printed elsewhere.

sbp_easydata.name: State Bank of Pakistan data
sbp_easydata.line: A data file downloaded from the State Bank's EasyData service. We use it to cross-check inflation figures.

cpi.name: Consumer prices and inflation
cpi.line: The consumer price index and inflation, national, urban and rural, by group of goods.

lfs.name: Jobs and the labour force
lfs.line: Labour force, employment, unemployment and participation, by sex, area and province.
